items.claim: Oral-B has great cardio for his weight class and is a strong grinder.
items.quote: Oral-B's good, man. He's a [...] grinder. And it seems that at this weight class, that gas tank is is good.

items.claim: Oral-B struggled cutting weight when he used to weigh 250-255 pounds.
items.quote: I know he struggled cutting weight to 250 255

items.claim: Neil Magny has virtually nothing left on the feet and anyone can check his chin now.
items.quote: Magny when he's 39 and has just about absolutely nothing on the feet. Like anybody can [...] check his chin now.

items.claim: Neil Magny can still secure takedowns and top time against Ramiz Brahimaj.
items.quote: he's got to get a takedown. But I mean, he can here, I think. I think he can get some takedowns and some top time in this fight.

items.claim: Ramiz Brahimaj has only been finished one time in his career.
items.quote: Brahma has only been finished one time.

items.claim: Neil Magny's losses throughout his career have exclusively come against extremely high-level fighters.
items.quote: Every time he's lost, they've been against [...] unbelievable fighters.

items.claim: Vicente Luque's chin is completely gone and acts as a major liability.
items.quote: his the chin is completely gone... his chin is is a liability

items.claim: Vicente Luque did not look good physically moving up to middleweight (185 pounds).
items.quote: Luque at 185, he did not look good at 185, man. [...] he was looking like a little like Gastelum in that in that fight physique-wise

items.claim: Tresean Gore throws a decent amount of volume and will be the bigger, stronger hitter against Luque.
items.quote: Gore's going to be the bigger guy, the stronger hitter... He throws a lot. Throws a lot of volume.

items.claim: Dante Johnson completely gassed out in his previous performance against Cody Brundage.
items.quote: Johnson coming off a performance against Cody Brundage like he had. Absolutely gassing the [...] out and stuff.
